column1: # logarch_triage_rules.tsv — rules read by logarch_triage.py. Edit freely, then re-run `logarch_local.sh triage <STAMP>`.
# Columns are separated by TWO or more spaces (or TABs):  kind  pattern  value  evidence
#   snapshot     token   → a path component containing "(token" or "_token" (case-insensitive) is a snapshot/backup copy
#   abandoned    glob    → path under logs/ ('*' also crosses '/'); first match wins
#   keep_render  glob    → GIF/MP4 renders under these paths stay in the curated layer (renders are dropped elsewhere)
#   group        glob    → curated/<group>/…; first match wins, so specific rules go first
# Snapshots and abandoned lines are EXCLUDED from curated/ by default (they stay in raw/), unless the thesis cites them.
snapshot     bf_          before-fix snapshot         repo convention: tools/clean_gifs/sweep/README.md ("(Bf_…)" dirs are dead, not cited in DA_in_Paper/Writing, 2026-09-19)
snapshot     archive      archived copy               repo convention: tools/clean_gifs/sweep/README.md
snapshot     smoke        smoke run                   repo convention: tools/clean_gifs/sweep/README.md
snapshot     legacy       legacy snapshot             repo convention: .claude/memory/archived-codes-is-dead-code.md
snapshot     outdated     outdated snapshot           repo convention: .claude/memory/archived-codes-is-dead-code.md
snapshot     abandoned    abandoned snapshot          repo convention: .claude/memory/archived-codes-is-dead-code.md
snapshot     incorrect    marked incorrect            folder name says so
snapshot     unfull       incomplete run              folder name says so
snapshot     before_u     pre-update copy             folder name says so (e.g. *_before_u12)
